searchText: <@689161464829050960> Any chance of renaming these folders with a date or number prefix so they are sorted correctly? <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/master/src/ethereum> I realize you're asking about the folders in the EELS implementation, but just ICYMI, there was an attempt to do this in `ethereum/execution-specs/tree/master/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades`. But it broke too many incoming links, so got reverted 😢 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/826 Couldn't you just leave the old links as aliases/symlinks? This is a _huge_ pet peeve of mine. Ugh. This tells me that changing it is, for some reason, very difficult or impossible. 😢 Unfortunately, Python modules have to be valid identifiers, and so cannot start with a number. a. b. c. That at least gets us up to fork 26. 😬 `aa_frontier` `ab_homestead` `ac_dao_fork` `ad_tangerine_whistle` . . . Having unsorted forks hurts me less than that naming convention though Your pain sensors need calibrating then. <@830368514225340436> <@243183686562873344> thoughts? <@689161464829050960> how about `upgrade` or `fork` as a prefix? ``` upgrade_001_frontier upgrade_002_homestead upgrade_003_dao_fork ``` Or maybe `f01_` or whatever
